name: Keep the review when the prose changes
description: Extracting a proposal's edited prose again carries the previous review over. A new intent with the same change, use case and description, ignoring case and whitespace, as a previously reviewed (non-proposed) intent takes its status, approvals, review note and original description. If instead the AI repeats the original reading of an amended intent for the same use case and quote, the amendment is reapplied with its approvals. Everything else stays proposed, so intents that changed lose their approvals. Decisions with the same question keep their answer when the option still exists, threads are kept, and the policy is kept. Decisions raised by the consistency check, and their intents, are not carried.
